name: Muesello's Greater Summoning Rune
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason
description: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
disable: DC 21 Acrobatics check to approach without triggering the trap followed by DC 23 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Summon Monster
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors.

Effect This trap summons a Living Landslide (PFS 3-11). The living landside rolls initiative and remains for 7 rounds, after which the spell ends and the living landside disappears. The living landside also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The summoned living landside can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.
